name: Astra
description: Self-hosted Stremio addon for your Xtream Codes IPTV subscription

XC_BASE_URL.description: Your Xtream panel URL, e.g. http://panel.example.com:8080

ADDON_SECRET.description: Random string that becomes part of your addon URL — the only lock on it

LIVE_TV.description: Set to false to hide the Live TV catalog

MY_TEAMS.description: Optional: comma list of team ids for the Live/Sports API (see README)

FEED_REGION_ORDER.description: Optional: preferred feed regions for the Live/Sports API, e.g. UK,US,IN,CA,other

KEEPALIVE_URL.description: Optional: your app's /healthz URL, pinged every 20 min so an Eco dyno never sleeps
